title: Sea Venture
html_source: The wreck of the Sea Venture, carrying emigrants to New England, in 1609; and the stranding of its passengers & crew in Bermuda are believed to have inspired The Tempest. It’s not clear why Stephen should refer to it coming home; it did not, though its passengers did reach America in two boats built in Bermuda.
